source.name: api.quran.com v4
source.note: Arabic and translation are verbatim from the API, as the app itself fetches them.

audio.note: Left channel of the source; summing L+R loses ~8 dB to phase cancellation.

verses.arabic: لَّا يَمْلِكُونَ ٱلشَّفَـٰعَةَ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱتَّخَذَ عِندَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ عَهْدًا
verses.english: None will have [power of] intercession except he who had taken from the Most Merciful a covenant.
And they say, "The Most Merciful has taken [for Himself] a son."
You have done an atrocious thing.

verses.english2: and the earth splits open and the mountains collapse in devastation

verses.english: That they attribute to the Most Merciful a son.

verses.arabic: وَمَا يَنۢبَغِى لِلرَّحْمَـٰنِ أَن يَتَّخِذَ وَلَدًا
verses.english: And it is not appropriate for the Most Merciful that He should take a son.

verses.arabic: إِن كُلُّ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ إِلَّآ ءَاتِى ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ عَبْدًا
verses.english: There is no one in the heavens and earth but that he comes to the Most Merciful as a servant.
He has enumerated them and counted them a [full] counting.
And all of them are coming to Him on the Day of Resurrection alone.

marks.note: enMark is the English counterpart of each ayah's closing rhyme word; the Arabic rhyme is the final token, found at build time.
